# REQUIRED MODELS: H3 Ref2V

The workflow selects the exact files below. Model files are not bundled with the workflow. Approximate space for the required weights: about 71 GB.

## Required for generation

- **Diffusion model (20.2 GB)**
  - File: **10Eros_Max_SingularityV2_PRISM2_PikaFlex_0.85_int8HQ.safetensors**
  - Folder: **models/diffusion_models/minimax/**
  - [Download from Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/OliviaRossi/Minimax-h3_Singularity-x-10Eros-Max_PRISM/resolve/main/10Eros_Max_SingularityV2_PRISM2_PikaFlex_0.85_int8HQ.safetensors)
  - This is the selected 10Eros/PRISM checkpoint, not the default Ref2V checkpoint shown in the UNET loader hint.
- **Text encoder (27.1 GB)**
  - File: **qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors**
  - Folder: **models/text_encoders/MiniMax/**
  - [Download from Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors)
  - The workflow selects INT8, not the NVFP4 alternative shown in the loader hint.
- **Video VAE (3.6 GB)**
  - File: **minimax_h3_sol_vae_fp16.safetensors**
  - Folder: **models/vae/minimax/video vae/**
  - [Download from Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_sol_vae_fp16.safetensors)
- **Audio VAE (605 MB)**
  - File: **minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors**
  - Folder: **models/vae/minimax/audio vae/**
  - [Download from Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors)

## Required for Describe and Draft

The LLM loader uses GGUF and needs both matching Gemma 4 files. Put both in **models/llm_gguf/**.

- **Gemma 4 GGUF (18.7 GB):** **Gemma4-31B-QAT-Uncensored-HauhauCS-Balanced-Q4_K_M.gguf** — [download](https://huggingface.co/HauhauCS/Gemma4-31B-QAT-Uncensored-HauhauCS-Balanced-MTP/resolve/main/Gemma4-31B-QAT-Uncensored-HauhauCS-Balanced-Q4_K_M.gguf).
- **Matching vision projector (1.2 GB):** **mmproj-Gemma4-31B-QAT-Uncensored-HauhauCS-Balanced-BF16.gguf** — [download](https://huggingface.co/HauhauCS/Gemma4-31B-QAT-Uncensored-HauhauCS-Balanced-MTP/resolve/main/mmproj-Gemma4-31B-QAT-Uncensored-HauhauCS-Balanced-BF16.gguf).
- **Gemma setting:** keep **n_ctx at 8192 or lower**.

## Optional: fast sampling preview

The Model Preview Override uses a tiny VAE for previews only; it does not affect the final video. Download [Kijai MiniMax-H3-TAE](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-TAE/resolve/main/vae_approx/taeh3.safetensors), save it under **models/vae_approx/** as **taeh3_model_preview.safetensors**.

## Hugging Face access

These links point to public model files and should not require Hugging Face login credentials. If Hugging Face asks you to accept a publisher license, sign in and accept it on your own account. Never put a password or access token in this workflow.

## Required custom-node repositories

Install these repositories for the custom nodes used by this workflow. The EM pack link is planned for after publication; the current workflow does not yet contain its Subject Hot Swap node.

### Planned EllipsesMark pack

- [EM Subject Hot Swap](https://github.com/EllipsesMark/EM-Subject-Hot-Swap) — install after the repository is published; this is the pack that will provide the Subject Hot Swap node.

### Required by nodes in this workflow

- [ComfyUI-Pixaroma](https://github.com/pixaroma/ComfyUI-Pixaroma) — `PixaromaSeed`, `PixaromaSaveMp4`.
- [ComfyUI LayerStyle](https://github.com/chflame163/ComfyUI_LayerStyle) — `LayerUtility: PurgeVRAM`.
- [ComfyUI-LG_SamplingUtils](https://github.com/LAOGOU-666/ComfyUI-LG_SamplingUtils) — `SigmasEditor`.
- [ComfyUI-H3-PowerLoraStack](https://github.com/cicalooo/ComfyUI-H3-PowerLoraStack) — H3 LoRA stack and schedule/modality nodes.
- [ComfyUI-H3-Motion-Context](https://github.com/NikoDemon80/ComfyUI-H3-Motion-Context) — H3 motion-context latent load/save nodes.
- [ComfyUI-KJNodes](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes) — `SetNode`, `GetNode`, and `ModelPreviewOverrideKJ`.
- [Geiru Context Suite](https://github.com/roycho87/geiru_context_suite) — Geiru/Clown context nodes. The workflow metadata includes both the legacy `clown_context_suite` and current `geiru_context_suite` IDs; these are one repository, not two installs.

### Optional workflow convenience

- [CRT-Nodes](https://github.com/PGCRT/CRT-Nodes) — provides `FancyTimerNode`, a display-only timer that is not needed to render the workflow.

ComfyUI's `comfy-core` nodes are built in and do not require another custom-node repository.
